description: Approximate landmarks manually placed on visible image features. Coordinates are normalized to each original image and are not biological dimensions or validated renderer controls.

annotations.evidence: Visible side of head. Base is approximate where the large head scales transition into neck scales. Night flash and perspective limit measurement.
Head visible from an elevated side angle. Head-neck boundary is approximate; this is a projected height, not dorsal head width.
Four consecutive light transverse markings on one visible body section. The curved body and lighting affect spacing; body width is a local projected width.
Three dark body bands visible on one foreground section. Curvature, flash and perspective affect the projected ratio.
